fields.name: token
fields.help: Web3.career API token generated at https://web3.career/web3-jobs-api after signing in ('Your token is for your use only … Do not share it'), sent as the token query parameter.

adapter.rate_note: Rate limited ('429 responses when exceeded'; back off exponentially); no figure is published. One request every five seconds.
adapter.terms: Mandatory link attribution: link to each job with its apply_url as a follow link and do not modify apply_url (https://docs.bondex.app/api-reference/web3-career-jobs-api). Keep the token private.

search_postings.note: GET https://web3.career/api/v1?token=&tag=&limit=&show_description=true (the single documented endpoint). `category` → tag, which must be ONE exact slug from the documented list (solidity, rust, defi, engineering, marketing, …) — 'Invalid tags silently return empty results'. There is no free-text, budget or offset parameter, so query and min_budget are not sent and page is ignored (limit 1–100). The body is a mixed array '[string, string, Job[]]'; jobs are read from element 2 ('typically'). url is apply_url — the required attribution link, never modify it; salary is free text in raw.salary; location/remote in raw.

not_offered.me: No account endpoint; the token is only a query parameter of /v1.
not_offered.get_posting: Single endpoint (/v1); no per-id lookup is documented — re-read the record from the search hit.
not_offered.submit_bid: No application endpoint; apply_url sends the applicant to the posting.
not_offered.credits: Free API; no credit or quota endpoint.
